measures.id: Bay County Proposal: Library Millage Renewal
measures.title: Library Millage Renewal
measures.summary: Would authorize Bay County to levy up to 1.7399 mills ($1.7399 per $1,000 of taxable value) for 2026 through 2031. It renews a library millage that expired in 2025. The money is for operating, maintaining and equipping the Bay County Library System and other library purposes; the first-year levy is estimated to raise about $6,690,559.
measures.yesMeans: Bay County could levy up to 1.7399 mills for the Bay County Library System for 2026 through 2031.
measures.noMeans: The library millage, which expired in 2025, would not be renewed.
